name: Dungeon Concierge
description:
About This Game

Become a Dungeon Janitor!

Dungeon Concierge is a fast-paced Dungeon Crawler where you will take the role of a wizard who has been employed by a shady company to restore dungeons and get them ready for the next batch of adventurers, using your magical powers and the environment to your advantage.

You are NOT the Hero!

You’ll prepare dungeons instead of looting them, fill up chests instead of emptying them and even set up enemies instead of killing them! 

Don't make a mess!

Enemies leave remains when you kill them. You’ll have to clean them up if you goof around playing the hero! However, traps and voids can help you deal with them. Make the most of your surroundings to avoid pay cuts and an increased workload!

You are a janitor AND a wizard!

The broom is alright but your magic is far much effective. Unlock and upgrade spells and find new ways to do your job! Using spells together results in powerful synergies. Get creative and use your magic to the fullest!

Escape or die!

If you take longer than expected to do your job you’ll enter OVERTIME! Enemies will start spawning left and right until you complete your tasks and escape, or die trying.

The true enemies are not who you think.

Our protagonist failed as a wizard and ended up taking a job as a dungeon concierge to earn a living. He works for Dungeon Masters LTD., a malevolent corporation that puts on dungeons for heroes to have their adventures. As their employee, he’s exploited, underpaid and micromanaged by the company’s very moody fairy mascot. She is in charge of relaying the company boss' orders to the employees with a meritocratic discourse. As our non-hero delves deeper into his job, he’ll discover that his true enemies are not those he encounters in the dungeons, but rather those who pull the strings from the shadows...
short_desc: Become an overworked wizard-janitor in this frenetic Dungeon Crawler where you clean instead of raiding. Complete contracts, master and upgrade your spells, create powerful synergies, and use the environment to dispatch foes without making a mess. All while surviving the corporate grind.
